mapper.sql: id, conversation_id AS conversationId, role, content, steps_json AS stepsJson, create_time AS createTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_conversation_message (conversation_id, role, content, steps_json) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{stepsJson})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_conversation_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY id ASC
